respuesta.razonamiento: The visual reading and narration describe a legacy migration and continuous synchronization pipeline from an on-premises IBM DB2 database to AWS DynamoDB and OpenSearch. The architecture consists of two main pipelines: a batch initial migration (DB2 -> DMS -> S3 -> EMR Spark ETL -> DynamoDB and OpenSearch) and an ongoing real-time CDC synchronization pipeline (DB2 / DMS -> Kinesis -> Lambda -> DynamoDB -> DynamoDB Streams -> Lambda -> OpenSearch). An API client queries OpenSearch. All 10 components from the whiteboard and narration are mapped to catalog services (IBM DB2 to ThirdParty, OpenSearch for Elasticsearch, UserCompanyAPI for client API). All 13 drawn lines are preserved, and the spoken DMS-to-Kinesis CDC flow is included.
respuesta.nombre: Legacy DB2 Migration and Real-Time Synchronization with AWS DMS, EMR, DynamoDB, and OpenSearch
